clips.note_zh: M 型卡扣，直段 50 mm。平板 68 宽贴砖背面，两侧立边 15 高，边缘 10 mm 唇边内折 16 度，开口收至 62.5，砖片需压入卡紧。2 个 3.5 直径固定孔。
clips.note_en: M-section snap clamp, 50 mm long. 68 flat behind the slip, 15 legs, 10 lips folded 16 deg in, mouth 62.5 so the slip snaps past. 2 off dia 3.5 fixing holes.

clips.note_zh: 按第 3 号板 T03 号砖型定制。该砖片最短边 10.7 mm（是砖的边长，不是卡扣的边长），整幅无 20 mm 以上等宽段，导轨卡扣无处可夹。折边：1 条边整条折起唇边（边长 8.5），1 条边在中部折一个 20 宽小卡扣；唇边一律向内折回扣住砖片，唇尖压进砖面 1.26 mm，与导轨卡扣的过盈量相同。斜边落在板边上，顶边落在 10 mm 灰缝里，两条都不折；托盘退到斜边内侧 0.5 mm，板边看不到金属，短边仍能折足 8.5 mm。2 个 3.5 直径固定孔。
clips.note_en: Made for board 3 type T03. The shortest edge of the SLIP is 10.7 mm (that is the brick, not the clip) and it has no 20 mm run of full width, so a rail has nothing to grip. The piece is held by 1 full-length lip, on the 8.5 edge and 1 centre tab 20 wide; every one of them folds INWARD back over the slip, gripping the slip face by 1.26 mm, the same interference as the rail. The rake is the board outline itself and the top sits in a 10 mm joint, so neither is folded; the tray stops 0.5 inside the rake, which keeps steel off the board edge and still leaves the short edge 8.5 of fold. 2 off dia 3.5 fixing holes.

clips.note_zh: 按第 8 号板 T02 号砖型定制。该砖片最短边 64.8 mm（是砖的边长，不是卡扣的边长），整幅无 20 mm 以上等宽段，导轨卡扣无处可夹。折边：3 条边各在中部折一个 20 宽小卡扣；唇边一律向内折回扣住砖片，唇尖压进砖面 1.26 mm，与导轨卡扣的过盈量相同。相邻边整条内折会在转角处打架，故每边只在中部留一个小卡扣，离转角 23 mm 以上。2 个 3.5 直径固定孔。
clips.note_en: Made for board 8 type T02. The shortest edge of the SLIP is 64.8 mm (that is the brick, not the clip) and it has no 20 mm run of full width, so a rail has nothing to grip. The piece is held by 3 centre tabs 20 wide; every one of them folds INWARD back over the slip, gripping the slip face by 1.26 mm, the same interference as the rail. Whole edges folding inward jam in the corners, so each edge keeps only a centre tab, over 23 mm clear of the nearest corner. 2 off dia 3.5 fixing holes.
